## ASX Announcement

DR MICHAEL BAKER COMMENCES AS CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER AND MANAGING DIRECTOR

Melbourne, Australia – 5 October 2026: Percheron Therapeutics Limited (ASX: PER) 
(‘the Company’), an international biotechnology company focused on developing novel 
therapies for oncology and rare diseases, is pleased to announce that Dr Michael Baker 
has officially commenced his role as Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director 
effective 5 October 2026. 
The Company announced the leadership transition for Dr Baker and former Chief 
Executive Officer and Managing Director Dr James Garner on 10 August 2026. 
Dr Baker is a highly experienced biotech executive and public company CEO. His most 
recent role was as Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director of Arovella 
Therapeutics (ASX: ALA), where he transformed a legacy business into one of Australia’s 
most compelling cell therapy companies. He holds a PhD in Biochemistry from La Trobe 
University and an MBA from the Melbourne Business School. Prior to joining Arovella, he 
served as a senior executive at a leading Australian biotechnology-focused venture 
capital fund. 
“The Board warmly welcomes Dr Baker to his new role with Percheron Therapeutics. His 
experience in drug development and capital markets will be a significant asset to the 
Company, and we feel confident that under his leadership the Company is well placed 
to unlock the full potential of its lead asset, HMBD-002,” commented Percheron Chair, 
Dr Charmaine Gittleson. 
Newly appointed CEO and MD, Dr Michael Baker, commented “I am incredibly excited to 
join Percheron at this important phase of the Company’s growth. We are in an excellent 
position with a unique VISTA-targeting mAb that has demonstrated excellent safety data 
and has multiple cost-effective pathways to generate promising efficacy data. I would 
like to thank James for his careful stewardship to date and the board for the faith and 
trust in me to lead the Company through this pivotal phase. I am committed to unlocking 
the value of our assets and generating value for all Percheron shareholders.” 
Upcoming Investor Roadshow 
As part of his commencement, Dr Baker will undertake an investor roadshow to meet 
with existing and prospective shareholders and provide an update on the Company's 
strategy, clinical development programs, and key priorities. 
Dr Baker will be holding investor meetings in Melbourne 20October 2026, Sydney 21 
October 2026 and Perth 22 and 23 October 2026. 
~ ENDS ~ 

F o r p e r s o n a l u s e o n ly

About Percheron Therapeutics Limited 
Percheron Therapeutics Limited [ASX: PER | US OTC: PERCF] is a publicly listed biotechnology 
company focused on the development and commercialisation of novel therapies for oncology 
and rare diseases. The company’s lead program is HMBD-002, a monoclonal antibody targeting 
the immune checkpoint regulator, VISTA. HMBD-002 has completed a phase I clinical trial in 
patients with advanced cancer, which has shown the drug to be generally safe and well 
tolerated, and Percheron aims to commence further clinical trials in CY2026. 
For more information, please contact info@PercheronTx.com. 
This announcement has been authorised for release to the Australian Securities Exchange 
by the Board of Directors.

# Percheron Therapeutics Installs Arovella Veteran Baker as CEO, Roadshow Set for October

Percheron Therapeutics (ASX: PER) has confirmed Dr Michael Baker commenced as chief executive officer and managing director on 5 October, completing the…

 By Rachel Underwood · 5 October 2026 · 2 min read 

Percheron Therapeutics (ASX: PER) has confirmed Dr Michael Baker commenced as chief executive officer and managing director on 5 October, completing the leadership transition announced in August when Dr James Garner stepped down from the role.

Baker joins from Arovella Therapeutics (ASX: ALA), where he served as CEO and managing director and oversaw the company's pivot into cell therapy. He holds a PhD in biochemistry from La Trobe University and an MBA from Melbourne Business School, with prior experience at a biotechnology-focused venture capital fund. Baker's capital markets background arrives as Percheron moves toward further HMBD-002 trials.

The appointment places a capital markets-experienced executive at the helm as Percheron prepares for further clinical development of HMBD-002, a monoclonal antibody targeting the immune checkpoint regulator VISTA. The company completed a Phase I trial in advanced cancer patients demonstrating the drug was generally safe and well-tolerated, and has flagged plans for additional trials in calendar year 2026.

"His experience in drug development and capital markets will be a significant asset to the Company, and we feel confident that under his leadership the Company is well placed to unlock the full potential of its lead asset, HMBD-002," chair Dr Charmaine Gittleson said.

Baker said Percheron was "in an excellent position with a unique VISTA-targeting mAb that has demonstrated excellent safety data and has multiple cost-effective pathways to generate promising efficacy data."

The transition follows Bell Wire's August report on Garner's departure and Baker's appointment. Percheron's July quarterly disclosed A$4.05 million in cash with plans to restart clinical activities following drug batch clearance.

Baker will meet existing and prospective shareholders at an investor roadshow in Melbourne on 20 October, Sydney on 21 October, and Perth on 22–23 October.

# Percheron Therapeutics installs new CEO as Baker takes helm from Garner

Dr Michael Baker has formally commenced as chief executive officer and managing director of Percheron Therapeutics (ASX: PER), completing a leadership transition first announced in August as the…

FC

Fiona Calder Health & Biotech · 5 Oct 2026 · 2 min read

Dr Michael Baker has formally commenced as chief executive officer and managing director of Percheron Therapeutics (ASX: PER), completing a leadership transition first announced in August as the biotech prepares to advance its lead oncology asset through further clinical development.

The appointment, effective Monday, brings to Percheron a veteran of the Australian cell therapy sector. Baker most recently served as CEO and managing director of Arovella Therapeutics (ASX: ALA), where he repositioned the company from a legacy business into a cell therapy developer. He holds a PhD in biochemistry from La Trobe University and an MBA from Melbourne Business School, with prior experience at a biotechnology-focused venture capital fund.

The transition follows the departure of Dr James Garner, who stepped down from the CEO role as announced on 10 August 2026. Garner had overseen Percheron through a period that included the completion of a Phase 1 clinical trial for its lead program, HMBD-002, a monoclonal antibody targeting VISTA, an immune checkpoint regulator involved in suppressing anti-tumour immune responses.

## Investor roadshow planned

Baker will move quickly to meet the market. The company has scheduled an investor roadshow across Melbourne on 20 October, Sydney on 21 October, and Perth on 22 and 23 October, covering Percheron’s strategy, clinical development programs and near-term priorities.

The roadshow timing aligns with a period of renewed clinical activity for the company. In late July, Percheron confirmed receipt of a cleared drug batch and flagged a September restart for clinical work, positioning the company to advance HMBD-002 into further trials during calendar year 2026.

## The clinical program

HMBD-002 has completed a Phase 1 trial in patients with advanced cancer. The trial established the drug as generally safe and well-tolerated, providing the foundation for Percheron to pursue additional studies. VISTA-targeting therapies represent a less crowded area of immuno-oncology compared with PD-1 and CTLA-4 inhibitors, though the pathway remains earlier in clinical validation.

Chair Dr Charmaine Gittleson said the board was confident Baker’s experience in drug development and capital markets would help unlock the potential of HMBD-002.

“We are in an excellent position with a unique VISTA-targeting mAb that has demonstrated excellent safety data and has multiple cost-effective pathways to generate promising efficacy data,” Baker said. “I am committed to unlocking the value of our assets and generating value for all Percheron shareholders.”

## What it means

Baker brings a track record of repositioning ASX-listed biotechs, and the roadshow timing suggests the board is moving quickly on both clinical development and capital markets.

The investor roadshow later this month will be the first opportunity for shareholders to hear Baker’s strategic priorities directly; the next material catalyst is the advancement of HMBD-002 into further clinical trials, with the company targeting additional studies in calendar 2026.

Percheron Therapeutics appoints Michael Baker as CEO as HMBD-002 trial approaches

# Percheron Therapeutics appoints Michael Baker as CEO as HMBD-002 trial approaches

 Proactive August 9, 2026 3 min read

Percheron Therapeutics appoints Michael Baker as CEO as HMBD-002 trial approaches Proactive uses images sourced from Shutterstock 

Percheron Therapeutics Ltd (ASX:PER, OTC:PERCF) has appointed experienced biotechnology executive Dr Michael Baker as managing director and chief executive officer, with the leadership change coming as the company prepares to advance its lead oncology asset, HMBD-002, into a new clinical trial in the second half of 2026. 

Baker will take up the role on October 5, 2026, succeeding Dr James Garner, who will step down as CEO and managing director on August 31, to pursue a new professional opportunity overseas. Garner will remain on Percheron's board as a non-executive director from September 1, providing continuity during the transition. 

#### Baker brings biotech development and public company experience 

Baker was most recently CEO and managing director of Arovella Therapeutics Ltd (ASX:ALA, FRA:E4NA), where he led the transformation of the former SUDA Pharmaceuticals into an oncology-focused cell therapy company. 

During his tenure, Arovella built a pipeline targeting blood cancers and solid tumours, with lead program ALA-101 receiving US Food and Drug Administration acceptance of its Investigational New Drug application in January 2026 ahead of an expected Phase 1 trial. 

Baker also previously worked at biotechnology venture capital fund BioScience Managers and at Hexima Ltd, where he was involved in translating drug development programs from discovery toward the clinic. 

Percheron chair Dr Charmaine Gittleson said Baker brought drug development, investment and public company experience to the role. 

Baker said his immediate priorities would be advancing HMBD-002, increasing engagement with the investment community and building on the company's existing development work. 

#### HMBD-002 remains key development focus 

The management transition does not alter Percheron's existing development timetable, with the company maintaining guidance that it expects to begin a new clinical trial of HMBD-002 during the second half of calendar 2026. 

HMBD-002 is a monoclonal antibody targeting VISTA, an immune checkpoint regulator. The therapy has completed a Phase 1 clinical trial in patients with advanced cancer, where Percheron reported that it was generally safe and well tolerated. 

The company describes HMBD-002 as Phase 2-ready, with Baker identifying advancement of the program as a central priority following his appointment. 

#### Shareholder-aligned remuneration package 

Baker will receive a base salary of $375,000 per annum plus superannuation, alongside short- and long-term incentive arrangements. 

His sign-on equity package comprises 75 million restricted stock units, subject to shareholder approval, with vesting tied to a combination of tenure and Percheron share price hurdles ranging from $0.005 to $0.015 based on a 20-day volume-weighted average price. 

The package also includes a target annual bonus equivalent to 50% of base salary and a target annual option grant equivalent to 1% of issued share capital, subject to performance conditions and required approvals. 

#### About Percheron Therapeutics 

Percheron Therapeutics is developing and commercialising novel therapies for oncology and rare diseases. 

Its lead program is HMBD-002, a monoclonal antibody targeting the VISTA immune checkpoint pathway.
